text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm Daiwa Scarlet. Pleased to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
My goal is to be the number one
Umamusume! I'm going to become the
absolute and undisputed best, and my
superiority will be plain for all to
see.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Which is why, as my trainer, you must
strive to
become number one as well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
